name: locally-uncensored
install: npm ci --cache /cache/npm && curl --proto =https --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal && /cache/cargo/bin/rustup component add llvm-tools-preview && (cd src-tauri && /cache/cargo/bin/cargo fetch --locked) && triple=$(/cache/cargo/bin/rustc -vV | awk '/^host:/{print $2}') && mkdir -p src-tauri/bin src-tauri/resources/llama/$triple dist && mkdir -p src-tauri/resources/llama/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && touch src-tauri/bin/lu-llama-server-$triple src-tauri/resources/llama/$triple/ggml-cpu-x64.so src-tauri/resources/llama/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/ggml-cpu-x64.so && printf '<!doctype html><title>benchmark placeholder</title>' > dist/index.html
notes: Vitest keeps the existing unit scope; Playwright, voice sidecar and GPU workloads remain excluded. Cargo collects the Tauri crate under src-tauri. The benchmark builds a Node 22 image with GTK/WebKit libraries during install, and caches rustup, llvm-tools-preview and crates for network-isolated collection. This image and the Tauri suite have not been exercised in Docker here. Install also stages the same sidecar and dist placeholders required by its Linux CI before cargo test. tauri.linux.conf.json names the x86_64 llama resource directory on every host, so install stages that placeholder too.

name: zotero-mcp
install: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs npm git && npm install --prefix /cache/node node@24.0.0 && python -m venv /cache/venv && /cache/venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]' && TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR=/cache/tiktoken /cache/venv/bin/python -c "import tiktoken; tiktoken.get_encoding('cl100k_base')" && cd plugin && PATH=/cache/node/node_modules/node/bin:$PATH npm ci --cache /cache/npm
notes: README uses pytest and release CI ignores test_lifespan.py. Dev extra supplies pytest and optional packages. Excludes live Zotero integration plan and test_lifespan; no Zotero service in container. Node 24 is installed into the cache volume in the Python image; report uses that binary and Cupel Python collector via PYTHONPATH. tiktoken downloads its encoding on first use, so the install step pre-fetches cl100k_base into the cache volume while the network is on. plugin/package.json runs node:test on TypeScript and requires Node 24; its tests are configured as a second runner. TypeScript source coverage uses the native Node collector. Scope excludes the built plugin bundle (plugin/dist).

name: Skill_Seekers
install: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs npm git && npm install --prefix /cache/node node@22.19.0 && python -m venv /cache/venv && /cache/venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && /cache/venv/bin/pip install -e '.[ui]' pytest-xdist pytest-timeout psutil
test: /cache/venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -q -m 'not slow and not integration and not e2e and not network and not serial and not mcp_only'

env.PYTEST_ADDOPTS: -m 'not slow and not integration and not e2e and not network and not serial and not mcp_only'

notes: Matches the unit lane in .github/workflows/tests.yml and its marker exclusions. Browser, vector DB, MCP-only and service suites are excluded. Node 22 is installed into cache in the Python image; the Cupel Python collector is on PYTHONPATH. Installs requirements.txt and the [ui] extra as separate steps, as its CI does; combined, pip cannot resolve them.

name: github-mcp-server
install: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs npm && npm install --prefix /cache/node node@26.0.0 && go mod download && go list -deps -test ./... > /dev/null && cd ui && PATH=/cache/node/node_modules/node/bin:$PATH npm ci --cache /cache/npm && PATH=/cache/node/node_modules/node/bin:$PATH npm run build
notes: go.mod requires Go 1.27.3; go mod download must cache the selected toolchain as well as modules. CONTRIBUTING.md and CI require ui npm ci/build before script/test, so install caches Node 26 and builds UI. Build-tagged live GitHub e2e with token is excluded. The install also runs go list -deps -test ./... so every module the packages and their tests import is cached before the offline stages. script/build-ui runs ui/package.json node:test on TypeScript under Node 26; configure that suite as node alongside Go. TypeScript UI source coverage uses the native Node collector. The baseline uses -count=1 so Go's test result cache cannot answer repeated runs (an earlier baseline measured cached 2 s runs after a 228 s first run), and omits CI's -race, which Cupel's collection does not use either.

name: zeron
install: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs npm && rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal && rustup component add llvm-tools-preview && npm install --prefix /cache/node node@22.19.0 && cargo fetch --locked
notes: Cargo workspace lockfile and macOS CI include these pure library crates. The Cargo collector selects packages from the test-file glob. Excludes native UI, voice/audio, GPU, browser fixtures, iOS and service tests. Collector benchmark has not been run.

name: activeagent
install: bundle_file=$PWD/gemfiles/rails8.gemfile && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs npm && npm install --prefix /cache/node node@22.19.0 && BUNDLE_GEMFILE=$bundle_file BUNDLE_PATH=/cache/bundle bundle install && cd test/dummy && BUNDLE_GEMFILE=$bundle_file BUNDLE_PATH=/cache/bundle RAILS_ENV=test bundle exec rails db:create db:migrate && cd ../.. && cd actionagent/frontend && PATH=/cache/node/node_modules/node/bin:$PATH npm ci --cache /cache/npm
notes: Mirrors the CI test lane with gemfiles/rails8.gemfile; Cupel collects the same files bin/test loads (test/** and actionagent/test/**), including the local Rails SQLite database setup, and runs bin/test. The benchmark container has no provider credentials or external services, so network-dependent tests may still fail. Dashboard frontend has a Node 22 npm test CI lane and is configured as node. The browser-sidecar lane needs a browser and sandbox setup, so remains excluded.
